# Spelling fixture

<!-- spelling-allow: Behavior Analysis Lab -->

We organize, analyse, and prioritize the catalogue. The colour of each
behaviour is modelled and labelled; artefacts are judged towards the centre of
the grey area, with judgement. Advise, comprise, and surprise keep their -ise.

Code is exempt: `color`, `analyze()`, color_map, `--normalise`, and
[a link](docs/behavior.md) or <https://example.org/color/center>. So is the
colorama package, and the Behavior Analysis Lab, a proper name.

```text
color behavior analyze
```
